note: Sources of the audio used to build and test the entropy-model tables. Only items whose own metadata states public domain, CC0 or CC-BY were downloaded (archive.org, OpenGameArt.org, kenney.nl); the audio itself is not redistributed here. Splits: fit / fit2 built the tables (every 8th fit clip, by sorted name, was held out as dev for the expert weights); test is the phase 1 test set; test2 is the phase 2 test set, whose creators never appear in fit2. `used_for` lists the EnCodec models for which a clip of this source had been encoded when the tables were built; an empty list means it was downloaded but not used. CC-BY items must be credited to `creator` with a link to `page` if their audio is reused.
